intro.en: Two friends talk about meals. You will learn the three meals of the day, foods like fish, rice and bread, and how to say 'a lot' and 'a little'.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein do dost khaane ke baare mein baat karte hain. Hum din ke teen khaane, machli, chawal aur roti jaise naam, aur 'bohat' aur 'thora' kehna seekhenge.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ صَديقانِ عَنِ الوَجَباتِ. تَتَعَلَّمُ وَجَباتِ اليَوْمِ الثَّلاثَ، وَأَطْعِمَةً مِثْلَ السَّمَكِ وَالأَرُزِّ وَالخُبْز، وَتَقولُ «كَثير» وَ«قَليل».

dialogue.ur: Salim, aap kahan ja rahe hain?

dialogue.en: How many meals do you eat in a day?
dialogue.ur: Aap din mein kitne khaane khate hain?

dialogue.ar: آكُلُ ثَلاثَ وَجَباتٍ: الفُطورَ وَالغَداءَ وَالعَشاءَ.
dialogue.tr: ākulu thalātha wajabātin: al-futūr wa l-ghadāʾ wa l-ʿashāʾ
dialogue.en: I eat three meals: breakfast, lunch and dinner.
dialogue.ur: Main teen khaane khata hun: nashta, dopahar ka khaana aur raat ka khaana.

dialogue.ar: هَذا كَثيرٌ جِدّاً. أَنا آكُلُ وَجْبَةً واحِدَةً.
dialogue.tr: hādhā kathīrun jiddan. anā ākulu wajbatan wāḥidah
dialogue.en: That is very much. I eat one meal.
dialogue.ur: Yeh bohat zyada hai. Main ek hi khaana khata hun.

dialogue.en: What do you eat for lunch?
dialogue.ur: Aap dopahar ke khaane mein kya khate hain?

dialogue.ar: آكُلُ اللَّحْمَ وَالدَّجاجَ وَالأَرُزَّ وَالخُبْزَ. وَماذا تَأْكُلُ أَنْتَ؟
dialogue.tr: ākulu l-laḥma wa d-dajāja wa l-aruzza wa l-khubz. wa mādhā taʾkulu ant?
dialogue.en: I eat meat, chicken, rice and bread. And what do you eat?
dialogue.ur: Main gosht, murghi, chawal aur roti khata hun. Aur aap kya khate hain?

dialogue.tr: ākulu s-samaka wa s-salaṭata wa l-fākihah
dialogue.en: I eat fish, salad and fruit.
dialogue.ur: Main machli, salad aur phal khata hun.

dialogue.tr: sittūna kīlan. wa mā waznuka ant?
dialogue.en: Sixty kilos. And what is your weight?
dialogue.ur: Saath kilo. Aur aap ka wazan kya hai?

q.ur: فَطور ka matlab kya hai?
Kaun sa lafz 'chawal' ke liye hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني طَعاماً أَبْيَضَ نَطْبُخُهُ في الحَبَّات؟

q.en: How many meals does Salim eat in a day?
q.ur: Salim din mein kitne khaane khata hai?
q.ar: كَمْ وَجْبَةً يَأْكُلُ سالِمٌ في اليَوْم؟

q.ur: نَحيف ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which question asks 'Where are you going?'
q.ur: Kaun sa sawal 'Aap kahan ja rahe hain?' hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ نَسْأَلُ بِهِ عَنِ المَكانِ الَّذي يَذْهَبُ إِلَيْهِ الشَّخْص؟

intro.en: A flight attendant asks a passenger what she would like to eat and drink. Learn how to ask politely using 'min fadlik' (please) and 'shukran' (thank you).
intro.ur: Jahaz ki mezban musafira se poochti hai ke woh kya khana aur peena chahegi. Hum 'min fadlik' (meherbani) aur 'shukran' (shukriya) ke saath adab se maangna seekhenge.
intro.ar: تَسْأَلُ مُضيفَةُ الطّائِرَةِ المُسافِرَةَ ماذا تُريدُ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ وَتَشْرَب. تَتَعَلَّمُ الطَّلَبَ بِأَدَبٍ بِقَوْلِكَ «مِنْ فَضْلِكَ» وَالشُّكْرَ بِقَوْلِكَ «شُكْراً».

dialogue.en: What would you like of food?

dialogue.tr: baʿḍa s-samaki wa l-aruzzi min faḍlik

dialogue.en: And what would you like of drink?
And which fruit do you prefer?
dialogue.ur: Aur phal mein aap kya pasand karengi?
Nahin, main coffee pasand karti hun.

q.ur: عِنَب ka matlab kya hai?
Kaun sa lafz 'mashroob' (peene ki cheez) hai?

q.en: What does the passenger prefer: tea or coffee?
q.ur: Musafira kya pasand karti hai: chai ya coffee?
مِنْ فَضْلِكَ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What do you say after شُكْراً to reply 'You are welcome'?
q.ur: شُكْراً ke jawab mein 'Koi baat nahin' kya kehte hain?

title.en: Dialogue 3: Lunch is on the table

intro.en: A husband comes home hungry. His wife says lunch is ready, but there are guests too! Learn words for husband, wife, guests, meat and chicken.
intro.ur: Shauhar bhooka ghar aata hai. Biwi kehti hai khaana tayyar hai, magar mehmaan bhi hain! Hum shauhar, biwi, mehmaan, gosht aur murghi ke alfaaz seekhenge.
intro.ar: يَعودُ الزَّوْجُ إلى البَيْتِ جائِعاً. تَقولُ لَهُ زَوْجَتُهُ إِنَّ الغَداءَ جاهِز، وَلَكِنَّ عِنْدَهُمْ ضُيوفاً! تَتَعَلَّمُ: زَوْج، زَوْجَة، ضُيوف، لَحْم، دَجاج.

dialogue.ur: Aur aap par bhi salamati ho.

dialogue.ar: ما هَذا؟! سَمَكٌ وَلَحْمٌ وَدَجاجٌ وَأَرُزٌّ وَسَلَطَةٌ وَفاكِهَةٌ! هَذا كَثيرٌ جِدّاً.
dialogue.tr: mā hādhā?! samakun wa laḥmun wa dajājun wa aruzzun wa salaṭatun wa fākihah! hādhā kathīrun jiddan
dialogue.en: What is this?! Fish, meat, chicken, rice, salad and fruit! This is too much.
dialogue.ur: Yeh kya hai?! Machli, gosht, murghi, chawal, salad aur phal! Yeh bohat zyada hai.

dialogue.en: Do not eat... do not eat. Sit down.
dialogue.ur: Mat khaaiye... mat khaaiye. Baith jaaiye.

dialogue.en: My father, my mother and my brother.
dialogue.ur: Mere walid, meri walida aur mera bhai.

q.ur: ضُيوف ka matlab kya hai?
Kaun sa lafz 'biwi' ke liye hai?

q.en: Why does the wife tell the husband not to eat?
q.ur: Biwi shauhar ko khaane se kyun rokti hai?
q.ar: لِماذا تَطْلُبُ الزَّوْجَةُ مِنْ زَوْجِها ألّا يَأْكُل؟

q.ur: أَنا جَوْعانُ ka matlab kya hai?
Mehmaan kahan hain?

intro.en: Here you practise food and drink words, then learn the ordinal numbers: first, second, third, fourth and fifth.
intro.ur: Yahan hum khaane peene ke alfaaz ki mashq karenge, phir tarteebi ginti seekhenge: pehla, doosra, teesra, chautha aur paanchwan.
intro.ar: تَتَدَرَّبُ هُنا عَلى كَلِماتِ الطَّعامِ وَالشَّرابِ، ثُمَّ تَتَعَلَّمُ الأَعْدادَ التَّرْتيبِيَّة: الأُولى، الثّانِيَة، الثّالِثَة، الرّابِعَة، الخامِسَة.

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz 'pehli' (muannas) ke liye hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى المَرْتَبَةِ الأولى لِلْمُؤَنَّث؟

q.ur: الخامِسَة ka matlab kya hai?
Kaun sa lafz 'teesri' ke liye hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى المَرْتَبَةِ الثّالِثَة؟

q.en: Which of these is a drink?
q.ur: In mein se kaun si peene ki cheez hai?

intro.en: Learn useful sentence patterns: 'Where is the lunch?', 'I eat...', 'What do you eat?', 'Some of...' and 'What do you ask for?'. Just swap in different words.
intro.ur: Kaam ke jumlon ke saanche seekhein: 'Khaana kahan hai?', 'Main khata hun...', 'Aap kya khate hain?', 'Thora sa...' aur 'Aap kya maangte hain?'. Bas alfaaz badalte jaayen.
intro.ar: تَتَعَلَّمُ أَنْماطَ جُمَلٍ مُفيدَة: أَيْنَ الغَداء؟ آكُلُ... ماذا تَأْكُلُ؟ بَعْضُ... ماذا تَطْلُب؟ بَدِّلِ الكَلِماتِ فَقَط.

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz 'kahan' ke liye hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ نَسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ المَكان؟

q.ur: عَلى ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Complete: ماذا ___ في الغَداءِ؟ (What do you eat for lunch?)
q.ur: Mukammal karein: ماذا ___ في الغَداءِ؟ (Aap dopahar ko kya khate hain?)
بَعْض ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: Listen carefully to two similar letters. ق (qāf) is deep in the throat. ك (kāf) is light and in the front of the mouth. Hear the difference in قَهْوَة (coffee) and كَثير (a lot).
intro.ur: Do milte julte huroof ko dhyan se sunein. ق (qaaf) halq ki gehrai se nikalta hai. ك (kaaf) halka hai aur munh ke aage se nikalta hai. Farq sunein: قَهْوَة (coffee) aur كَثير (bohat).
intro.ar: أَصْغِ جَيِّداً إلى حَرْفَيْنِ مُتَشابِهَيْن. القافُ ق صَوْتُها عَميقٌ في الحَلْق، وَالكافُ ك خَفيفَةٌ في مُقَدِّمَةِ الفَم. اسْمَعِ الفَرْقَ في «قَهْوَة» وَ«كَثير».

q.en: Which letter is pronounced deep in the throat?
q.ur: Kaun sa harf halq ki gehrai se bola jata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ يَخْرُجُ عَميقاً مِنَ الحَلْق؟

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz ق se shuru hota hai?
Kaun sa lafz ك se shuru hota hai?
قالوا ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: Now practise speaking with a friend. Ask what they eat and drink, what they would like, and how many meals they eat each day.
intro.ur: Ab dost ke saath bol kar mashq karein. Poochein woh kya khata peeta hai, kya maangta hai, aur din mein kitne khaane khata hai.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الكَلامِ مَعَ صَديقِك: اسْأَلْهُ ماذا يَأْكُلُ وَيَشْرَب، وَماذا يُحِبُّ، وَكَمْ وَجْبَةً يَأْكُلُ كُلَّ يَوْم.

dialogue.en: What do you eat for lunch?
dialogue.ur: Aap dopahar ko kya khate hain?

q.en: How do you ask 'What do you eat?'
q.ur: 'Aap kya khate hain?' kaise poochte hain?

q.en: How do you say 'I drink tea'?
q.ur: 'Main chai peeta hun' Arabic mein kaise kehte hain?

q.en: Which word begins a yes/no question?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz haan/na wale sawal ko shuru karta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَبْدَأُ بِها سُؤالاً جَوابُهُ نَعَمْ أَوْ لا؟

q.en: What do you say to ask politely for some fish?
q.ur: Adab se thori machli maangne ke liye kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا تَقولُ لِتَطْلُبَ بَعْضَ السَّمَكِ بِأَدَب؟

intro.en: Read a short paragraph about Zaynab and what she eats and drinks every day. Practise reading carefully, then answer questions.
intro.ur: Zainab ke baare mein chhota sa paragraph parhein ke woh roz kya khati peeti hai. Dhyan se parhein aur phir sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: اقْرَأْ فِقْرَةً قَصيرَةً عَنْ زَيْنَبَ وَما تَأْكُلُهُ وَتَشْرَبُهُ كُلَّ يَوْم. اقْرَأْ بِانْتِباه ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَة.

dialogue.ar: زَيْنَبُ سَمينَةٌ جِدّاً. تَأْكُلُ ثَلاثَ وَجَباتٍ في اليَوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: Zaynabu samīnatun jiddan. taʾkulu thalātha wajabātin fī l-yawm
dialogue.en: Zaynab is very fat. She eats three meals a day.
dialogue.ur: Zainab bohat motee hai. Woh din mein teen khaane khati hai.

dialogue.ar: تَأْكُلُ في الفُطورِ السَّمَكَ وَتَشْرَبُ القَهْوَةَ، وَتَأْكُلُ في الغَداءِ اللَّحْمَ وَتَشْرَبُ الشّايَ.
dialogue.tr: taʾkulu fī l-futūri s-samaka wa tashrabu l-qahwa, wa taʾkulu fī l-ghadāʾi l-laḥma wa tashrabu sh-shāy
dialogue.en: At breakfast she eats fish and drinks coffee, and at lunch she eats meat and drinks tea.
dialogue.ur: Nashte mein woh machli khati aur coffee peeti hai, aur dopahar mein gosht khati aur chai peeti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتَأْكُلُ في العَشاءِ الدَّجاجَ وَتَشْرَبُ الحَليبَ. وَزْنُ زَيْنَبَ مِئَةُ كيلو.
dialogue.tr: wa taʾkulu fī l-ʿashāʾi d-dajāja wa tashrabu l-ḥalīb. waznu Zaynaba miʾatu kīlū
dialogue.en: At dinner she eats chicken and drinks milk. Zaynab's weight is 100 kilos.
dialogue.ur: Raat ko woh murghi khati aur doodh peeti hai. Zainab ka wazan sau kilo hai.

vocab.ur: woh khati hai / aap khate hain
woh peeti hai / aap peete hain

q.en: How many meals does Zaynab eat a day?
q.ur: Zainab din mein kitne khaane khati hai?
q.ar: كَمْ وَجْبَةً تَأْكُلُ زَيْنَبُ في اليَوْم؟

q.en: What does Zaynab drink at breakfast?
q.ur: Zainab nashte mein kya peeti hai?

q.en: What does Zaynab eat at dinner?
q.ur: Zainab raat ko kya khati hai?
Zainab ka wazan kitna hai?

intro.en: Learn how the letters ك, ل, ن, ف, ق and م change shape at the start, middle and end of a word. Then listen and review the whole unit.
intro.ur: Seekhein ke huroof ك، ل، ن، ف، ق aur م lafz ke shuru, beech aur aakhir mein kaise shakl badalte hain. Phir pori unit ki dohrai karein.
intro.ar: تَتَعَلَّمُ كَيْفَ تَتَغَيَّرُ أَشْكالُ الحُروفِ ك ل ن ف ق م في أَوَّلِ الكَلِمَةِ وَوَسَطِها وَآخِرِها. ثُمَّ تَسْتَمِعُ وَتُراجِعُ الوَحْدَةَ كُلَّها.

q.en: Which word starts with the letter ك?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz harf ك se shuru hota hai?

q.en: Which word starts with the letter ل?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz harf ل se shuru hota hai?
لِماذا ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word starts with the letter ف?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz harf ف se shuru hota hai?

q.en: What is the opposite of نَعَمْ?
q.ur: نَعَمْ ka ulta kya hai?
